title: TrafficGamer: Reliable and Flexible Traffic Simulation for Safety-Critical Scenarios with Game-Theoretic Oracles
abstract: arXiv:2408.15538v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While modern Autonomous Vehicle (AV) systems can develop reliable driving policies under regular traffic conditions, they frequently struggle with safety-critical traffic scenarios. This difficulty primarily arises from the rarity of such scenarios in driving datasets and the complexities associated with predictive modeling of multiple vehicles. Effectively simulating safety-critical traffic situations is therefore a crucial challenge. In this paper, we introduce TrafficGamer, which facilitates game-theoretic traffic simulation by viewing common road driving as a multi-agent game. When we evaluate the empirical performance across various real-world datasets, TrafficGamer ensures both the fidelity, exploitability, and diversity of the simulated scenarios, guaranteeing that they not only statically align with real-world traffic distribution but also efficiently capture equilibria for representing safety-critical scenarios involving mul

translated_title: TrafficGamer：基于博弈论预言机的面向安全关键场景的可靠灵活交通仿真
translated_abstract: 尽管现代自动驾驶（AV）系统能够在常规交通条件下开发出可靠的驾驶策略，但它们在应对安全关键的交通场景时经常遇到困难。这一困难主要源于此类场景在驾驶数据集中的稀少性，以及多车辆预测建模的复杂性。因此，有效仿真安全关键的交通状况成为一个至关重要的挑战。在本文中，我们提出了TrafficGamer，它通过将常见道路驾驶视为多智能体博弈来促进博弈论交通仿真。当我们在多个真实世界数据集上评估其实证性能时，TrafficGamer确保了仿真场景的保真度、可利用性和多样性，保证了这些场景不仅在静态上与真实世界交通分布保持一致，还能高效捕捉均衡状态，从而表示涉及多辆车的安全关键场景。
tldr: TrafficGamer提出了一种博弈论交通仿真框架，通过将道路驾驶建模为多智能体博弈，生成了同时具备保真度、可利用性和多样性的安全关键交通场景。
en_tdlr: TrafficGamer introduces a game-theoretic traffic simulation framework that models road driving as a multi-agent game, generating safety-critical scenarios that ensure fidelity, exploitability, and diversity across real-world datasets.
